Input.EntryRecovery.Blocked.zh: 系统输入状态仍显示以下按键按下：{0}。请按下并释放这些键，然后点击悬浮图标或按编辑快捷键重试。
Input.EntryRecovery.Blocked.en: The system input state still reports these keys as pressed: {0}. Press and release them, then click the floating icon or use the editing shortcut to retry.

Input.EntryRecovery.Unknown.zh: 等待按键释放已超时，本次未进入编辑。请释放键盘和鼠标按键，然后点击悬浮图标或按编辑快捷键重试。
Input.EntryRecovery.Unknown.en: Waiting for keys to be released timed out. Editing did not start. Release keyboard and mouse buttons, then click the floating icon or use the editing shortcut to retry.
